<div align="center">
    <h1>
        Zabbix Template SMSEagle by HTTP
    </h1>
    <h4>
        Monitoring SMSEagle SMS gateway devices via HTTP API v2
    </h4>
    <br>
</div>
<br>
<br>

<!-- *********************************************************************************************************************************** -->
<!-- *** BODY ************************************************************************************************************************** -->
<!-- *********************************************************************************************************************************** -->
## Description
This template monitors SMSEagle SMS gateway devices (NXS, MHD series) using the SMSEagle HTTP API v2. It collects modem status, signal strength, SIM registration, message counters, firmware and support information, HA failover state, service statuses, and temperature sensor readings. The template uses a master item + dependent item architecture for efficient data collection, with LLD for automatic modem and temperature sensor discovery.

## Requirements
- **Zabbix 7.0+** with HTTP agent and Script item support
- SMSEagle device with **firmware 6.30+** (required for device/service/temperature endpoints)
- API v2 access token generated on the SMSEagle device
- Network connectivity from Zabbix server/proxy to the SMSEagle device (HTTPS recommended)

## Installation

### 1. Generate an API token on the SMSEagle device
1. Log in to the SMSEagle **Web-GUI**
2. Go to **Users** menu
3. Create a new user with access level **User** (or use an existing one)
4. Click **Access to API** next to the user
5. Select **APIv2** and click **Generate new token**
6. In **APIv2 Permission** section, enable the following permissions:

   **Messages** section:
   - `GET` **Count messages**

   **Modem** section:
   - `GET` **Get full modem information**

   **Device** section:
   - `GET` **Get HA failover state**
   - `GET` **Get device support information**
   - `GET` **Get device software version information**
   - `GET` **Get SNMP service status**
   - `GET` **Get MQTT service status**
   - `GET` **Get Email2SMS service status**
   - `GET` **Get Email2SMS Poller service status**
   - `GET` **Get data connection information**
   - `GET` **Get SMPP service status**
   - `GET` **Get status of temperature sensor**
   - `GET` **Get last reading from temperature sensor**

7. Optionally enable **Access to resources of all users** if you want to see message counts from all users
8. Copy the generated token -- you will need it in step 4

### 2. Import the Template
Download and import the [SMSEagle by HTTP Template](./7.0/template_smseagle_http_7.0.yaml) into your Zabbix server.

### 3. Link Template to Host
Create a Zabbix host for your SMSEagle device and link the imported template.

### 4. Configure Template Macros
Set the required macros on the host level:

| Macro | Description | Default |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| `{$HOST.API.SMSEAGLE}` | IP address or hostname of the SMSEagle device | `192.168.220.33` |
| `{$SCHEMA.API.SMSEAGLE}` | API connection schema | `https` |
| `{$TOKEN.API.SMSEAGLE}` | SMSEagle API access token (secret) | -- |
| `{$SMSE.MIN.SIGNAL.STRENGTH}` | Minimum acceptable signal strength (0-100%) | `50` |
| `{$SMSEAGLE.NODATA.TIMEOUT}` | No data timeout (must be > 1h DISCARD heartbeat) | `75m` |
| `{$SMSEAGLE.TEMP.HIGH}` | High temperature threshold (Celsius) | `60` |
| `{$SMSEAGLE.ERROR.THRESHOLD}` | Minimum message error count increase to alert | `5` |

## Monitoring scope

### Messages
- Total message counts: delivered, sent, inbox, outbox, error
- Message error increase detection

### Modem discovery (LLD)
- Automatic discovery of all modems in the device
- Per-modem: signal strength (%), SIM status, SIM network registration, modem enabled status
- Per-modem: IMEI, IMSI, phone number, network name

### Device information
- Firmware version and update availability
- Support package status and expiration date
- HA failover state (Disabled / Master / Backup / Fault)

### Service statuses
- MQTT, SNMP, Data connection, Email2SMS, Email2SMS Poller, SMPP
- Collected via a single Script item making 6 API calls

### Temperature sensor discovery (LLD)
- Automatic discovery of temperature sensors (IDs 1-4)
- Per-sensor: temperature (Celsius) and humidity (%)

## Triggers

| Trigger | Severity |
|---------|----------|
| No data from messages API | High |
| No data from modem API | High |
| Message errors increasing (>= threshold) | Warning |
| Firmware update available | Information |
| Support package expired | High |
| HA failover in fault state | High |
| Modem not functional (per modem) | High |
| Modem SIM status not operational (per modem) | Warning |
| Modem SIM not registered (per modem) | Average |
| Modem signal strength low (per modem) | Average |
| Temperature too high (per sensor) | Average |
